description: This file defines the ApiController class within the SuiteCRM API v8 namespace. It manages JSON API responses, error handling, and request validation for the SuiteCRM REST API, including version info and dependencies.

classes.name: ApiController
classes.description: Controller class handling JSON API responses, error management, and request validation for SuiteCRM API v8.

methods.name: generateJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Generates a JSON API formatted response, including version info and validation.

methods.name: handleExceptionIntoPayloadError
methods.description: Converts an exception into a JSON API error object and adds it to the response payload.

methods.name: generateJsonApiErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a JSON API error response based on an exception.

methods.name: negotiatedJsonApiContent
methods.description: Validates request Content-Type and Accept headers for JSON API compliance.

methods.name: validateRequestWithJsonApiSchema
methods.description: Validates incoming request payload against JSON API schema.

methods.name: getVersionMajor
methods.description: Returns the major version number of the API.

methods.name: getVersionMinor
methods.description: Returns the minor version number of the API.

methods.name: getVersionPatch
methods.description: Returns the patch version number of the API.

methods.name: getVersionStability
methods.description: Returns the stability stage of the API.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger instance for the controller.
